# ChromeStatusLite

> Fast, zero-JavaScript, server-rendered reader over the Chrome Platform Status API (`chromestatus.com/api/v0`) with Baseline status from `webstatus.dev`. Built by Paul Kinlan for quick access to Chrome release details for both humans and agents that cannot run JavaScript.

## For Agents & Content Negotiation

- **Markdown on every page:** Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any HTML route (for example `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://chromestatuslite.com/`) to receive clean Markdown with `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`, `Vary: Accept`, absolute links, and GFM tables.
- **No JavaScript required:** Every HTML page is complete server-rendered semantic HTML.
- **Public JSON API:** Milestone data is available as CORS-enabled JSON at `https://chromestatuslite.com/api/version/latest` and `https://chromestatuslite.com/api/version/{milestone}`.

## Core Pages

- [Home / Latest Chrome Release](https://chromestatuslite.com/): Release summary grouped by Enabled by default, Origin trial, Behind a flag, Deprecated, and Removed. Pass `?version={milestone}` (e.g. `https://chromestatuslite.com/?version=135`) for any Chrome milestone.
- [Compare Releases](https://chromestatuslite.com/diff): Side-by-side comparison of two Chrome releases (`?from={m1}&to={m2}`).
- [Breaking Changes Timeline](https://chromestatuslite.com/breaking): Deprecated APIs, removals, and breaking changes across recent Chrome milestones with enterprise impact.
- [Origin Trials Tracker](https://chromestatuslite.com/origin-trials): Active, upcoming, and historical Chrome Origin Trials.
- [Deprecation Calendar](https://chromestatuslite.com/deprecations): Table of deprecated/removed features sorted by Chrome milestone and estimated UTC stable date.
- [Feature Detail](https://chromestatuslite.com/feature/{id}): Full details for a ChromeStatus feature ID — summary, motivation, Baseline status & browser versions (`webstatus.dev`), cross-browser signals (Firefox, Safari, web developers), WPT results, specs, docs, and samples.
- [Feature Snapshot History](https://chromestatuslite.com/feature/{id}/history): Change history captured lazily as readers view `/feature/{id}`.
- [Feature Snapshot Diff](https://chromestatuslite.com/feature/{id}/diff): Field-by-field diff between stored captures (`?from={iso}&to={iso}`).
- [Topic Wiki Directory](https://chromestatuslite.com/wiki): Curated web platform topic pages with cross-browser consensus, stage groupings, and timelines.
- [About ChromeStatusLite](https://chromestatuslite.com/about): Background on Paul Kinlan and why ChromeStatusLite was created.

Each slug resolves at `https://chromestatuslite.com/wiki/{slug}`:

- [WebGPU](https://chromestatuslite.com/wiki/webgpu)

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Latest Milestone JSON](https://chromestatuslite.com/api/version/latest): JSON payload with `version`, `stable_date`, `total_features`, `features_by_type`, and `features`.
- [Milestone JSON by Number](https://chromestatuslite.com/api/version/{milestone}): Same JSON schema for any available integer Chrome milestone.
- [RSS 2.0 Feed](https://chromestatuslite.com/feed.xml): Recent Chrome releases (`?limit=1..25`, default 10).

- [Paul Kinlan](https://paul.kinlan.me/): Creator of ChromeStatusLite.
